## Component & Styling Checklist
- [ ] **Plain-English Classes Only**: Uses intuitive classes (e.g. `button green`, `card elevated`, `grid 3`).
- [ ] **Zero Utility Abbreviations**: Avoids cryptic classes (such as `px-4`, `bg-blue-500`, `flex`).
- [ ] **Strict Zero-Emoji Policy**: No unicode emojis in component markup, styles, or docs. Vector SVGs only.
- [ ] **Zero Build Compiler**: Core remains standard pure CSS and lightweight HTML.
- [ ] **Responsive & Accessible**: Tested on mobile and supports keyboard navigation.
